bear.meet.1.speaker: burl
lines: Quite a fall you took, sky-cub.

bear.meet.2.speaker: you
lines: ...You just spoke.

bear.meet.3.speaker: burl
lines: I did.

bear.meet.4.speaker: you
lines: Bears don't talk.

bear.meet.5.speaker: burl
lines: And people don't fall from the sky.
Yet here you are.

bear.meet.6.speaker: you
lines: This isn't possible.

bear.meet.7.speaker: burl
lines: You folk from the loud hill are odd.
You believe a balloon can fly,
but a bear with words troubles you?

bear.crash.1.speaker: burl
lines: Hard to miss a burning sky-boat.
Thought the whole hill would catch fire.

bear.crash.2.speaker: you
lines: It's called an airship.

bear.crash.3.speaker: burl
lines: Not much of one now.

bear.q.offer.1.speaker: burl
lines: If you're heading west, mind the woods.
Boars have taken over my berry slope.
Mean things. No respect for blueberries.

bear.q.offer.2.speaker: you
lines: I'm looking for something.

bear.q.offer.3.speaker: burl
lines: Aren't we all?

bear.q.offer.4.speaker: you
lines: A light. It blinks in the distance.

bear.q.offer.5.speaker: burl
lines: Ah. The far light.
There is an old Waystone past the trees.
Might help you find your way.
But first, those boars need moving.

bear.q.accepted.speaker: burl
lines: Five ought to convince the others.
Mind their tusks, sky-cub.

bear.q.later.speaker: burl
lines: Then sit a while. The boars will still be rude.

bear.q.active.speaker: burl
lines: Still hearing those greedy snouts.
Five boars. No need to chase the whole herd.

bear.q.ready.1.speaker: burl
lines: Ah! I can smell the berries again!

bear.q.ready.2.speaker: you
lines: The path is clear.

bear.q.ready.3.speaker: burl
lines: And my breakfast is saved.
What's that in your paw? It glows.

bear.q.ready.4.speaker: you
lines: It was under the last boar.

bear.q.ready.5.speaker: burl
lines: So that's what they were rooting for.
Keep it close. Old stones like that light.

bear.q.ready.6.speaker: burl
lines: You've done an old bear a kindness.

bear.follow.1.speaker: burl
lines: Come along, sky-cub.
I'll show you that old stone.

bear.follow.2.speaker: you
lines: You're coming with me?

bear.follow.3.speaker: burl
lines: Wouldn't want you getting lost.
You already fell out of the sky once.

bear.stone.1.speaker: burl
lines: There we are.
The Waystone.

bear.stone.2.speaker: you
lines: It's an old machine.

bear.stone.3.speaker: burl
lines: Not quite.

bear.stone.4.speaker: you
lines: Looks like one.

bear.stone.5.speaker: burl
lines: That's because you look with your eyes.

bear.stone.6.speaker: you
lines: What else should I look with?

bear.stone.7.speaker: burl
lines: Your head, for a start.
These stones remember those who wake them.
If you fall, their light calls you home.
They remember your journey too.
And when you wake another stone,
you can travel between them.

bear.stone.8.speaker: you
lines: Without walking?

bear.stone.9.speaker: burl
lines: That's the idea.

bear.stone.10.speaker: you
lines: That's impossible.

bear.stone.11.speaker: burl
lines: You've said that before.
Try holding that crystal to the bowl.

bear.woken.1.speaker: you
lines: What is that?

bear.woken.2.speaker: burl
lines: An old kind of light.

bear.woken.3.speaker: you
lines: No gears. No steam.

bear.woken.4.speaker: burl
lines: Not everything needs them.
Well done, sky-cub.
The next stone lies west, by the road bend.
Follow the old road and your little chart.

bear.woken.5.speaker: you
lines: You're not coming?

bear.woken.6.speaker: burl
lines: These paws have walked far enough today.
And my berries won't eat themselves.

bear.woken.7.speaker: you
lines: Thank you, Burl.

bear.woken.8.speaker: burl
lines: Take care out there.
The world is wider than your Wall.

bear.departing.speaker: burl
lines: Go on, sky-cub. The road is west.

bear.repeat.speaker: burl
lines: Back again? The berries are still mine. Mostly.
